items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: Is he related to One Eyed Babe?

ctx.x: The best I heard was a little son of Joseph Phillips. He's in Pacific, Florida. He got off this guy on Bay 5. He was about the best I heard around my time.
Is he related to One Eyed Babe?
No, he ain't no really. His native home is in Natchez, Mississippi. But he left there and he's a young fellow and come here.
